thread:
tasha: Heads-up  post-migration anchor weirdness: several deep links under /guides/installer and /guides/cluster jump to the top instead of the section. Got two support reports.
ben: Do you have examples?
tasha: /guides/installer#service-accounts and /guides/cluster#autoscale-example. Both land at the top.
li: CI linkcheck flagged these too. Snippet: 'ERROR: Fragment not found: #service-accounts (in /guides/installer)'.
docs-bot: linkcheck: 6 broken fragments in build 4444. Report: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/4444/linkcheck
ben: Likely causes: (a) heading got wrapped in an MDX component during conversion (slug changed); (b) heading became indented code block so no slug; (c) list-context headings got different slug rules.
tasha: Quick triage: run a grep for indented headings and list-context patterns. Example I ran: `rg "^\s{4,}#{1,6} " docs/guides | sed -n '1,120p'` and found a couple in installer.md.
li: For immediate stability: add explicit IDs on the most-linked headings, e.g. `## Service accounts {#service-accounts}` and unindent any accidental code-block headings. That fixes user-facing links quickly.
ben: For long-term compatibility we should generate a slug-compat map: scan git history for old heading lines, compute old slugs (mkdocs rules), compute current slugs, diff and emit a redirects.json for Docusaurus. I'll sketch a small generator script and push a draft PR.
tasha: Can we also add a tiny linkcheck unit in CI that asserts a handful of canonical anchors exist post-merge? Saves another round of regressions.
li: Yes. Add a short JSON list in `.github/actions/linkcheck` that CI reads. If anchors missing, fail early.
docs-bot: artifact: slug dump available at https://ci.redwood.dev/build/4444/slugs.json
ben: Short sequence: 1) tasha patches installer/cluster with explicit ids & fixes (content PR); 2) ben pushes slugmap + sample redirects.json; 3) li adds linkcheck assertion and we re-enable strict link checks.
tasha: Also add a one-line note in the PR description: "explicit id added to preserve external deep links after migration" so reviewers don't change them inadvertently.
li: If we land content fixes before redirects exist, consider setting `onBrokenLinks: 'warn'` temporarily in docusaurus config to avoid blocking deploys. Notify infra in the PR.
asha: (typo) will do. I'll open the PR this afternoon and ping here.
ben: Draft slugmap PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1507 (WIP)  contains generator and sample redirects.json.
docs-bot: Reminder: nightly build at 02:00 UTC will re-run linkcheck after merges.
li: Great work. Ping here when PRs are ready and I'll run a manual linkcheck before merging.
